subject: Re: iALS status: decision - 10-seed protocol adopted, closing April 27
body:
All,

Decision: the 10-seed protocol is adopted as proposed - the baseline ships with mean and standard deviation over 10 repetitions, and the Evalline gate is mean minus one sigma. I'd rather have teams grumble about a strict gate than have the platform bless noise as progress.

Close-out plan for April 27: Rosa finishes packaging (both dataset configs plus the holdout-generation script), Linnea writes the two-page tuning recipe, Bilal freezes the final numbers table. Handoff meeting with Tomas Fofana's Evalline team is booked for the last week of April.

One caveat for the write-up: the py2.7 container is a reproduction artifact, not a supported dependency - the packaged baseline itself is py3-only. Please make that unmissable so nobody cargo-cults a 2.7 runtime into production.

Good, unglamorous work - this is what platform credibility is made of.

Dmitri
